text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency SLO breach on /v1/generate in us-west-2 — p99=4.2s (SLO 2.0s), p95=1.1s. Streaming stalls observed (streaming stalled for > 250ms in >5% of traces). Prefix cache hit rate dropped sharply. Runbook: /runbooks/prefix-cache-mitigation

ashley (oncall-eng): I'm paged, jumping in. Noted deploy webhook: prefix-hash-v2 rollout completed ~10m ago. Pulling metrics now.

devin (runtime): @ashley saw the same. Prefix cache hit went from ~92% to ~18% coincident with the rollout. KV bucket distribution also shows much higher cardinality for prefixes. Suspect hash change + new prefix normalization logic.

maria (sre): Confirmed increased tail CPU on runtimes handling streaming. Streaming thread queues backpressureing when cache misses cause long model lookups. p99 spike correlates with miss-rate increase.

ashley (oncall-eng): Are there customer-facing errors? Sam, any support tickets?

sam (support): A few customers reporting slow streaming and truncated responses (timeouts) — highest volume from AcmeCorp and BetaRetail. Logged customer-impact flags and set priority.

devin (runtime): Quick triage: two knobs we can flip: 1) rollback the prefix-hash-v2 rollout (fast but touches routing) 2) enable hot-warm bucket warmup + aggressive caching for common prefixes (safer, takes time). Recommend rollback for immediate relief if rollback path is tested.

kevin (prodinfra): Rollback plan requires a small control-plane action. ops-bot shows the rollout was done via canary=100% 10m ago. We can revert to prefix-hash-v1 with the deploy tool. Revert time ~3-5m, plus cache warm-up.

maria (sre): Also can we short-circuit to fallback model variant for streaming (lower-latency small model) to reduce tail while we fix cache? That's lower blast radius but might change quality.

ashley (oncall-eng): I want immediate mitigation with minimal customer impact: 1) enable fallback-to-small-model route for streaming on affected region 2) kick rollback if fallback doesn't reduce p99 in 5m. Who can flip these?
devin (runtime): I can flip fallback routing via runtime feature flag now. Pushing flag: `runtime.flags.streaming_fallback_usw2 = true`
ops-bot: Deploy action queued by devin — applying runtime feature flag to 10 clusters in us-west-2.
ashley (oncall-eng): Meanwhile, kevin — please prepare rollback docs and test plan in case fallback is insufficient.
kevin (prodinfra): prepping. Quick checklist I'll follow:
- validate rollback artifact for prefix-hash-v1
- ensure control-plane rollback doesn't evict healthy caches unexpectedly
- coordinate with runtime to drain gracefully

sam (support): Notifying AcmeCorp CSM that we have an active mitigation for streaming latency and will update in 30m.

maria (sre): Metrics update 2m after fallback flag: p95 unchanged, p99 down from 4.2s -> 2.3s (partial improvement). Streaming stall rate down from 5.3% -> 2.1%. Need more.

devin (runtime): Given partial improvement, I'm starting a selective rollback of prefix-hash-v2 on a single shard to validate. Command I ran: 
```
# rollback to v1 for shard-07
infra deploy rollback --service prefix-hash --shard shard-07 --to-tag prefix-hash-v1
```
Logs show rollback completed on shard-07 and hit rate there recovered to 88% within 20s.

maria (sre): Nice — that aligns. If shard rollback reproduces recovery, we should do a staged rollback across shards.

ashley (oncall-eng): OK plan: staged rollback across shards in 5m waves until p99 back under 2s or we hit a rollback throttle. Devin/kevin coordinate. Sam to keep customers updated.

devin (runtime): Starting staged rollback wave 1 (shards 01-05). Monitoring cache hit, p99, streaming stalls.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] rollback-wave-1 started by devin at 1934568040.

ops-bot: Rollback jobs enqueued (5 shards). ETA per shard ~45s.

maria (sre): After wave 1: global cache hit up to 52%, p99 -> 1.9s, streaming stalls -> 1.0%. Passing SLO threshold for p99.

kevin (prodinfra): Continuing wave 2 (remaining shards). I'll throttle if we see control-plane contention.

ashley (oncall-eng): Good. Start notifying on-call handoff in 30m: I'll compile mitigation timeline and actions. If any shard fails rollback, stop and escalate.

sam (support): Customer update: AcmeCorp and BetaRetail notified. No new tickets since mitigation started.

devin (runtime): Final note: root cause likely the hash permutation in prefix-hash-v2 + a normalization change that increased key cardinality for certain input tokenizations (we saw heavy growth in prefix variants for conversational prompts). We'll open a postmortem once stabilized.

ashley (oncall-eng): Handoff notes for next on-call (maria):
- Incident: p99 latency SLO breach due to prefix cache miss surge after prefix-hash-v2 rollout.
- Mitigations applied: streaming_fallback flag, staged rollback to prefix-hash-v1 across shards, monitoring restored.
- Customer impact: AcmeCorp and BetaRetail had slow streaming/truncations; support alerted.
- Followups: detailed postmortem, revert verification, long-term fix (hashing compatibility tests + canary watch for cache-hit regression).

maria (sre): Taking handoff. Will keep watches for 2h and start postmortem template.

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] p99 SLO back within limits (p99=1.8s) and streaming stalls below threshold. Incident marked mitigated at 1934568520.

ashley (oncall-eng): Thanks all. Will create incident ticket and assign followups: ownership: devin (runtime) for fix, kevin (prodinfra) for safer rollout process, maria (sre) for monitoring/tests.

sam (support): I'll follow up with impacted customers with post-incident summary.

devin (runtime): Adding logs we captured for postmortem: 
```
# sample cache miss spike trace
ts=2026-03-12T12:42:15Z shard=03 prefix="user:conv:\u003clong_token_variant\u003e" misses=12 latency_ms=1200
```
Will include reproducer and hash diffs in the PM.

maria (sre): Closing handoff. Marking oncall status -> monitoring. :eyes:
